title: One-round nonlinear-schedule Even-Mansour full-XRKA frontier
summary: Close the query-complexity gap for one-round Even--Mansour with low-differential-uniformity nonlinear key derivation under full XOR-related-key attacks.

formal_statement.body: For $\operatorname{EM}[n,1,\gamma]$ with one public random permutation and key-derivation permutations $\gamma_0,\gamma_1$ of bounded differential uniformity, determine the adaptive bidirectional XOR-related-key security frontier throughout the unresolved Figure 4 region between Theorem 3 and the source-cited single-key attack, by proving matching security and attack bounds.

scope.domain: One-round Even--Mansour with nonlinear key derivation under adaptive bidirectional XOR-related-key attacks.
assumptions: $\gamma_0$ and $\gamma_1$ are permutations with bounded differential uniformity.
Construction and public-permutation queries are adaptive and bidirectional.
scope.unresolved_remainder: The full query region between Theorem 3 and the compatible single-key attack is not characterized by matching bounds.

citations.label: Cogliati--Seurin, IEM under related-key and chosen-key attacks
citations.locator: Open Problems, printed p. 6; Figure 4 and surrounding text, printed pp. 11-15

progress.summary: The source identifies the second unresolved Figure 4 region for one-round nonlinear-schedule Even--Mansour.
